# PipelineOn Open Attribution

> MIT-licensed website attribution, normalized business outcomes and optional Meta and Google Ads delivery. Start at START-HERE.md.

Use files from the same commit as the installed package. The links below follow main and may be newer than a downloaded release; replace main with the installed tag/commit when needed. Read package.json and local validation before implementing. These documents describe capabilities and do not grant account access, spending or publication authority.

The v0.3 kit uses Node.js 24.14.x and persistent SQLite. Cloudflare Workers can host a separately implemented adapter, not the unchanged kit. Hosted PipelineOn and the kit have different API wrappers. A worksheet is not executable configuration.

## Setup sequence

- [START-HERE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/START-HERE.md): Choose hosted or self-hosted and follow the full connection sequence.
- [AI-SETUP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/AI-SETUP.md): Copyable coding-assistant task, owner inputs and handoff requirements.
- [PIXEL-EVENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/PIXEL-EVENTS.md): Consent, source parameters, browser reference handoff and actual outcomes.
- [FIELD-MAPPING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/FIELD-MAPPING.md): CRM object meanings, relationships, event IDs, revisions and money.
- [DEPLOYMENT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/DEPLOYMENT.md): Persistent Node/SQLite hosting and optional Cloudflare adapter requirements.
- [ACCEPTANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/ACCEPTANCE.md): Source, revenue, replay, recovery and real provider verification.

- [SETUP-RECIPES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/SETUP-RECIPES.md): Server/free choices, Railway deployment, optional Worker proxy and offline/CRM recipes.
- [GTM.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/GTM.md): Web-container installation with consent grant and withdrawal handling.
- [META-SETUP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/META-SETUP.md): Facebook dataset, private token, matching prerequisites and real Test Events verification.

## Contracts and connectors

- [EVENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/EVENTS.md): Canonical business facts, platform mappings, consent and server matching normalization.
- [GOOGLE-ADS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/GOOGLE-ADS.md): Google Ads Data Manager setup, validation-only mode and asynchronous processing receipts.

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/README.md): Main repository guide, runtime, outcome contract, Meta and assistant tools.
- [INTEGRATIONS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/INTEGRATIONS.md): Distinct kit and PipelineOn API wrappers and middleware duties.
- [CALLRAIL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/CALLRAIL.md): Website number pool, captured cookies, verified webhook and call refresh.
- [CRM-ACCESS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/CRM-ACCESS.md): CRM access options and provider limitations.

## Private worksheets and samples

- [examples/setup-brief.template.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/examples/setup-brief.template.json): Installation worksheet; no secret values and not runtime configuration.
- [examples/crm-mapping.template.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/examples/crm-mapping.template.json): CRM mapping worksheet; not a POST payload or automatic connector.
- [examples/form.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zaclive/pipelineon-attribution-kit/main/examples/form.json): Synthetic standalone saved-enquiry payload; replace IDs, times and session.
